title: Doulce memoire (Sandrin)
desc: Pierre Sandrin, Doulce memoire, before 1538. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0033); edited by Franz Körndle, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
